name: Comprehend Languages
description: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken and written language. It takes about 10 rounds to read one page of text.
summary: Understand any spoken or written language.

name: Disguise Self
description: An illusion covers your entire body to alter your appearance. Physical interaction can’t extend for the illusive parts.
summary: An illusion changes how you look.

name: Conjure Familiar
description:
You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose such as cats, frogs, ferrets, crows, hawks, snakes, owls, ravens, toads, weasels, or even mice.
A creature acting as a familiar can benefit a wizard, conveying its sensory powers to its master, conversing with him, and serving as a guard/scout/spy as well.
A familiar have 1d4 hit points plus 1 hit point per caster level, and an AC of 10 + Caster level. It can’t attack but can deliver close (touch) spells.
A wizard can have only one familiar at a time, however, and he has no control over what sort of creature answers the summoning, if any at all come.
summary: An animal spirit serves you as scout and spy.

name: Thunderwave
description:
A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you out to a close area around where you stand.
Creatures and objects within the area of effect are pushed 10 feet away from you.
summary: Push everything close to you 10 feet away.

name: Create Undead
description: You conjure a vengeful undead creature to do your bidding. When you cast this spell, you choose to summon either a wight or wraith. It appears next to you and is under your control. The undead creature acts on your turn. After 1 day, it melts away into smoke.
summary: Summon a wight or wraith under your control for a day.

name: Acid Arrow
description: You conjure a corrosive bolt that hits one foe, dealing 1d6 damage a round. The bolt remains in the target for as long as you focus.
summary: One foe takes 1d6 damage each round while you focus.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport yourself and willing creatures within close range to a specified location on your same plane with a 50% chance of arriving off-target if the location is unknown.
summary: Teleport yourself and close allies anywhere on this plane.

name: Resilient Sphere
description: You conjure a weightless, glassy sphere around you that extends out to close range. For the spell's duration, nothing can pass through or crush the sphere. You can roll the sphere a near distance on your turn.
summary: An unbreakable glass sphere surrounds you.

name: Detect Magic
description: You can sense the presence of magic within near range for the spell's duration. If you focus for two rounds, you discern its general properties. Full barriers block this spell.
summary: Sense magic within near; focus to learn what it does.

name: Burning Hands
description: You spread your fingers with thumbs touching, unleashing a circle of flame that roars out to a close area around where you stand. Creatures within the area of effect take 1d6 damage, and flammable objects catch fire.
summary: A ring of flame deals 1d6 to everything close.

name: Holy Weapon
description: One weapon you touch is imbued with a sacred blessing. The weapon becomes magical and has +1 to attack and damage rolls for the duration.
summary: A touched weapon becomes magical, +1 to hit and damage.

name: Zone Of Truth
description: Compel a creature you can see to speak the truth while within range. They cannot utter a deliberate lie.
summary: A creature you see cannot tell a deliberate lie.

name: Divination
description: You throw the divining bones or peer into the blackness between the stars, seeking a portent. You can ask the GM one yes or no question. The GM truthfully answers "yes" or "no." If you cast this spell more than once in 24 hours, treat a failed spellcasting check for it as a critical failure, instead.
summary: Ask the GM one yes-or-no question.

name: Alarm
description: You touch one object, such as a door threshold, setting a magical alarm on it. If any creature you do not designate while casting the spell touches or crosses past the object, a magical bell sounds in your head.
summary: A mental bell rings when anyone crosses a touched object.

name: Hold Monster
description: You paralyze one creature you can see within range. If the target is LV 9+, it may make a STR check vs. your last spellcasting check at the start of its turn to end the spell.
summary: Paralyze one creature you can see.

name: Dimension Door
description: You teleport yourself and up to one other willing creature to any point you can see.
summary: Teleport you and one ally to a point you can see.

name: Passwall
description: A tunnel of your height opens in a barrier you touch and lasts for the duration. The passage can be up to near distance in length and must be in a straight line.
summary: Open a tunnel through a barrier you touch.

name: Prismatic Orb
description: Send a strobing orb of energy streaking toward a target within range. Choose an energy type from fire, cold, or electricity. The orb deals 3d8 damage and delivers a concussive blast of the chosen energy type. If the energy type is anathema to the target's existence, the orb deals double damage to it.
summary: An energy orb deals 3d8 fire, cold or lightning.

name: Mage Armor
description: An invisible layer of magical force protects your vitals. Your armor class becomes 14 (18 on a critical spellcasting check) for the spell’s duration.
summary: Your AC becomes 14 (18 on a critical).

name: Smite
description: You call down punishing flames on a creature you can see within range. It takes 1d6 damage.
summary: Punishing flames deal 1d6 to a creature you see.

name: Silence
description: You magically mute sound in a near cube within the spell’s range. Creatures inside the area are deafened, and any sounds they create cannot be heard.
summary: Mute all sound in a near cube.

name: Fireball
description: You hurl a small flame that erupts into a fiery blast. All creatures in a near-sized cube around where the flame lands take 4d6 damage.
summary: A fiery blast deals 4d6 in a near cube.

name: Judgment
description: You instantly banish a creature you touch, sending it and all possessions it carries to face the judgment of your god. You can banish an intelligent creature of LV 10 or less. When the creature returns in 5 rounds, it has been healed to full hit points if its deeds pleased your god. It has been reduced to 1 hit point if its deeds angered your god. If your god can't judge its actions, it is unchanged.
summary: Banish a creature to face your god's judgment.

name: Mass Cure
description: All allies within near range of you regain 2d6 hit points.
summary: All allies within near regain 2d6 HP.

name: Levitate
description: You can float a near distance vertically per round on your turn. You can also push against solid objects to move horizontally.
summary: Float up or down a near distance each round.

name: Knock
description: A door, window, gate, chest, or portal you can see within range instantly opens, defeating all mundane locks and barriers. This spell creates a loud knock audible to all within earshot.
summary: Instantly open a door, lock or portal, loudly.

name: Feather Fall
description: You may make an attempt to cast this spell when you fall. Your rate of descent slows so that you land safely on your feet.
summary: Cast as you fall to land safely.

name: Dominion
description: Mighty beings come to your aid. The beings must have a combined total of 20 levels or less. Chaotic PCs summon demons/devils, and lawful or neutral PCs summon angels. The beings act of free will to aid you on your turn. After 10 rounds, they return to their realms. You cannot cast this spell again until you complete penance.
summary: Summon angels or demons, up to 20 levels, for 10 rounds.

name: Polymorph
description: You transform a creature you touch into another natural creature you choose of equal or smaller size. Any gear the target carries melds into its new form. The target gains the creature's hit points, armor class, and attacks, but retains its intellect. If the target goes to 0 hit points, it reverts to its true form at half its prior hit points. You can target any willing creature with this spell, or an unwilling creature whose level is less than or equal to half your level rounded down (minimum 1).
summary: Turn a touched creature into another natural creature.

name: Sending
description: You send a brief, mental message to any creature with whom you are familiar who is on the same plane.
summary: Send a short mental message to someone you know.

name: Mirror Image
description: Create a number of illusory duplicates of yourself equal to half your level rounded down (minimum 1). Each time a creature attacks you, the attack misses and causes one of the duplicates to evaporate. If all the illusions have disappeared, the spell ends.
summary: Illusory doubles absorb attacks against you.

name: Restoration
description: With the touch of your hands, you expunge curses and illnesses. One curse, illness, or affliction of your choice affecting the target creature ends.
summary: End one curse, illness or affliction on a touched target.

name: Heal
description: One creature you touch is healed to full hit points. You cannot cast this spell again until you complete a rest.
summary: Heal one touched creature to full HP.

name: Illusion
description: You create a convincing visible and audible illusion that fills up to a near-sized cube in range. The illusion cannot cause harm, but creatures who believe the illusion is real react to it as though it were. A creature who inspects the illusion from afar must pass a Wisdom check vs. your last spellcasting check to perceive the false nature of the illusion. Touching the illusion also reveals its false nature.
summary: Create a convincing sight-and-sound illusion.

name: Rebuke Unholy
description: Rebuke creatures who oppose your alignment, forcing them to flee. You must present a holy symbol to cast this spell. If you are lawful or neutral, this spell affects demons, devils, and outsiders. If you are chaotic, this spell affects angels and natural creatures of the wild. Affected creatures within near of you must make a CHA check vs. your spellcasting check. If a creature fails by 10+ points and is equal to or less than your level, it is destroyed. Otherwise, on a fail, it flees from you for 5 rounds.
summary: Force opposing creatures near you to flee.

name: Scrying
description: You look into a crystal ball or reflecting pool, calling up images of a distant place. For the spell's duration, you can see and hear a creature or location you choose that is on the same plane. This spell is DC 18 to cast if you try to scry on a creature or location that is unfamiliar to you. Each round, creatures you view may make a Wisdom check vs. your last spellcasting check. On a success, they become aware of your magical observation.
summary: See and hear a distant creature or place.

name: Commune
description: You seek your entity's counsel. Ask the GM up to three yes or no questions. The GM truthfully answers "yes" or "no" to each. If you cast this spell more than once in 24 hours, treat a failed spellcasting check for it as a critical failure, instead.
summary: Ask the GM up to three yes-or-no questions.

name: Fly
description: Your feet lift from the ground, and you take to the air like a hummingbird. You can fly near for the spell's duration and are able to hover in place.
summary: Fly a near distance and hover in place.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: You peer into the mind of one creature you can see within range. Each round, you learn the target’s immediate thoughts. On its turn, the target makes a Wisdom check vs. your last spellcasting check. If the target succeeds, it notices your presence in its mind and the spell ends. "Magic is simply the art of doing and undoing." -Creeg, human wizard
summary: Read the surface thoughts of a creature you see.

name: Sleep
description: You weave a lulling spell that fills a near-sized cube extending from you. Choose a number of living creatures in the area up to to your level. Those creatures fall into a deep sleep if they are LV 2 or less. Vigorous shaking or being injured wakes them.
summary: Creatures of LV 2 or less in a near cube fall asleep.

name: Wrath
description: Weapons become magical +2 and deal an additional d8 damage for the spell's duration.
summary: Weapons become +2 and deal an extra d8.

name: Cloudkill
description: A putrid cloud of yellow poison fills a near-sized cube within range. It spreads around corners. Creatures inside the cloud are blinded and take 2d6 damage at the beginning of their turns. A creature of LV 9 or less that ends its turn fully inside the cloud dies.
summary: A poison cloud blinds and deals 2d6 each turn.

name: Protection From Energy
description: One creature you touch becomes impervious to the wild fury of the elements. Choose fire, cold, or electricity. For the spell's duration, the target is immune to harm from energy of the chosen type.
summary: A touched creature becomes immune to fire, cold or lightning.

name: Invisibility
description: A creature you touch becomes invisible for the spell’s duration. The spell ends if the target attacks or casts a spell.
summary: A touched creature turns invisible until it attacks.

name: Blind/Deafen
description: You utter a divine censure, blinding or deafening one creature you can see in range. The creature has disadvantage on tasks requiring the lost sense.
summary: Blind or deafen one creature you see.

name: Recover
description: A creature you touch regains 1d4 hit points on your turn for the duration. This spell also regrows lost body parts.
summary: A touched creature regains 1d4 HP each turn and regrows limbs.

name: Turn Undead
description: Present a holy symbol and force undead creatures within near range to flee or be destroyed on a failed CHA check vs. your spellcasting check.
summary: Undead near you flee or are destroyed.

name: Flame Strike
description: You call down a holy pillar of fire, immolating one creature you can see within range. The target takes 2d6 damage.
summary: A holy pillar of fire deals 2d6 to one creature.

name: Augury
description: You interpret the meaning of supernatural portents and omens. Ask the GM one question about a specific course of action. The GM says whether the action will lead to “weal” or “woe.”
summary: Learn if a course of action leads to weal or woe.

name: Disintegrate
description: A green ray shoots from your finger and turns a creature or object into ash. A target creature of LV 6 or less instantly dies. If it is LV 7+, it takes 5d6 damage, instead. A non-magical object up to the size of a large tree is destroyed.
summary: A green ray turns a creature or object to ash.

name: Dispel Magic
description:
End one spell that affects one target you can see in range.
For higher tiers, make a spellcasting check as if you’re casting the targeted spell.
summary: End one spell on a target you see.

name: Animate Dead
description: You touch one humanoid’s remains, and it rises as a zombie or skeleton under your control. The remains must have at least three limbs and its head intact. The undead creature acts on your turn. After 1 day, the creature collapses into grave dust.
summary: Raise a corpse as a zombie or skeleton for a day.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A protective force wrought of your holy conviction surrounds you. You gain a +2 bonus to your armor class for the duration.
summary: +2 to your AC.

name: Cleansing Weapon
description: One weapon you touch is wreathed in purifying flames. It deals an additional 1d4 damage (1d6 vs. undead) for the duration.
summary: A touched weapon deals +1d4 (1d6 vs. undead).

name: Divine Vengeance
description: You become the divine avatar of your god's wrath, wreathed in holy flames or a black aura of smoldering corruption. For the spell's duration, you can fly a near distance, your weapons are magical, and you have a +4 bonus to your weapon attacks and damage.
summary: Fly, and gain +4 to weapon attacks and damage.

name: Hold Portal
description: You magically hold a portal closed for the duration. A creature must make a successful STR check vs. your spellcasting check to open the portal. The knock spell ends this spell.
summary: Hold a door shut; opening it takes a STR check.

name: Charm Person
description: You magically beguile one humanoid of LV 2 or less within near range, who regards you as a friend for the duration. The spell ends if you or your allies do anything harmful to the target. The target knows it was magically charmed after the spell ends.
summary: A humanoid of LV 2 or less sees you as a friend.

name: Light
description: One object you touch glows with bright, heatless light, illuminating out to a near distance for 1 hour of real time.
summary: A touched object glows out to near for 1 hour.

name: Misty Step
description: In a puff of smoke, you teleport a near distance to an area you can see.
summary: Teleport a near distance to a spot you see.

name: Arcane Eye
description: You conjure an invisible, grape-sized eye within range. You can see through the eye. It can see in the dark out to near range, fly near on your turn, and squeeze through openings as narrow as a keyhole.
summary: An invisible flying eye you can see through.

name: Antimagic Shell
description: An invisible, near-sized cube of null-magic appears centered on you. Within the cube, no spells can be cast. Magic items and spells have no effect in the zone, and no magic can enter. The cube moves with you. Spells such as dispel magic have no effect on it. Another antimagic shell does not affect this one.
summary: No magic works in a near cube around you.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: You shoot a blue-white ray of lightning from your hands, hitting all creatures in a straight line out to a far distance. Creatures struck by the lightning take 3d6 damage.
summary: A line of lightning deals 3d6 out to far.

name: Confusion
description: You mesmerize one creature you can see in range. The target can't take actions, and it moves in a random direction on its turn. If the target is LV 9+, it may make a WIS check vs. your last spellcasting check at the start of its turn to end the spell.
summary: A creature can't act and wanders at random.

name: Magic Circle
description: Conjure a circle of runes around yourself and name a type of creature. Creatures of the chosen type cannot attack or cast hostile spells on anyone inside the circle, and can't possess, compel, or beguile anyone inside the circle.
summary: A rune circle wards off one type of creature.

name: Fabricate
description: This spell can't target creatures. You turn a tree-sized collection of raw materials into a finished work. For example, you convert a pile of bricks or rocks into a bridge. The finished work converts back to raw materials when the spell ends.
summary: Turn raw materials into a finished work.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Your touch restores ebbing life. Roll a number of d6s equal to 1 + half your level (rounded down). One target you touch regains that many hit points.
summary: A touched target regains (1 + half level) d6 HP.

name: Command
description: You issue a verbal command to one creature in range who can understand you. The command must be one word, such as “kneel.” The target obeys the command for as long as you focus. If your command is ever directly harmful to the creature, it may make a Charisma check vs. your last spellcasting check. On a success, the spell ends.
summary: A creature obeys a one-word command.

name: Floating Disk
description: You create a floating, circular disk of force with a concave center. It can carry up to 20 gear slots. It hovers at waist level and automatically stays within near of you. It can’t cross over drop-offs or pits taller than a human.
summary: A floating disk carries 20 gear slots for you.

name: Plane Shift
description: You fold space and time, transporting yourself and all willing creatures within close range to a location on another plane of your choice. Unless you have been to your intended location before, you appear in a random place on the destination plane.
summary: Travel with close allies to another plane.

name: Hold Person
description: You magically paralyze one humanoid creature of LV 4 or less you can see within range.
summary: Paralyze a humanoid of LV 4 or less.

name: Shapechange
description: You transform yourself and any gear you carry into another natural creature you've seen of level 10 or less. You gain the creature's hit points, armor class, and attacks, but retain your intellect. If you go to 0 hit points while under the effects of this spell, you revert to your true form at 1 hit point.
summary: Turn into a natural creature of LV 10 or less.

name: Wish
description: Alter reality with a single wish, interpreted by the GM. A failed spellcasting check is treated as a critical failure and rolls the mishap with disadvantage.
summary: Alter reality with a single wish.

name: Power Word Kill
description: Utter the Word of Doom. One creature you target of LV 9 or less dies if it hears you. Treat a failed spellcasting check for this spell as a critical failure, and roll the mishap with disadvantage.
summary: A creature of LV 9 or less that hears you dies.

name: Summon Extraplanar
description: Reach into the outer planes and summon an elemental or outsider of LV 7 or less under your control. If you lose focus, you lose control and the creature becomes hostile towards you and your allies. A spellcasting check is required to return the creature to the outer planes.
summary: Summon an elemental or outsider of LV 7 or less.

name: Control Water
description: You move and shape water. You can cause a section of water up to 100 feet in width and depth to change shape, defy gravity, or flow in a different direction.
summary: Move and reshape up to 100 feet of water.

name: Telekinesis
description: Lift a creature or object weighing 1,000 pounds or less and move it in any direction or hold it in place.
summary: Lift and move up to 1,000 pounds with your mind.

name: Web
description: Creates a near-sized cube of sticky spider web within range. Creatures stuck in the web must succeed on a Strength check vs. your spellcasting check to free themselves.
summary: Sticky webs fill a near cube and trap creatures.

name: Protection From Evil
description: For the spell's duration, chaotic beings have disadvantage on attack rolls and hostile spellcasting checks against the target. These beings also can't possess, compel, or beguile it. When cast on an already-possessed target, the possessing entity makes a CHA check vs. the last spellcasting check. On a failure, the entity is expelled.
summary: Chaotic beings struggle to harm or possess the target.

name: Alter Self
description: You magically change your physical form, gaining one feature that modifies your existing anatomy. For example, you can grow functional gills on your neck or bear claws on your fingers. This spell can’t grow wings or limbs.
summary: Grow one new feature, like gills or claws.

name: Pillar Of Salt
description: A creature you target turns into a statue made of hardened salt. You can target a creature you can see of LV 5 or less. If you focus on this spell for 3 rounds in a row, the transformation becomes permanent.
summary: Turn a creature of LV 5 or less into salt.

name: Gaseous Form
description: You and your gear turn into a cloud of smoke for the spell's duration. You can fly and pass through any gap that smoke could. You can sense the terrain and any movement around you out to a near distance. You can't cast spells while in this form.
summary: Become smoke that flies through any gap.

name: Magic Missile
description:
A glowing bolt of force streaks from your open hand, dealing 1d4 damage to one target.
Wizards (Class) have advantage on checks to cast this spell.
summary: A bolt of force deals 1d4 to one target.

name: Fixed Object
description: An object you touch that weighs no more than 5 pounds becomes fixed in its current location. It can support up to 5,000 pounds of weight for the duration of the spell.
summary: Fix a small object in place; it holds 5,000 pounds.

name: Speak With Dead
description: A dead body you touch answers your questions in a distant, wheezing voice. You can ask the dead body up to three yes or no questions (one at a time). The GM truthfully answers "yes" or "no" to each. If you cast this spell more than once in 24 hours, treat a failed spellcasting check for it as a critical failure, instead.
summary: A corpse answers three yes-or-no questions.

name: Stoneskin
description: Your skin becomes like granite. For the spell's duration, your armor class becomes 17 (20 on a critical spellcasting check).
summary: Your AC becomes 17 (20 on a critical).

name: Wall Of Force
description: Conjures a contiguous, transparent wall of force in a near-sized area of your choice that blocks physical objects on the same plane.
summary: An invisible wall blocks everything physical.

name: Bless
description: One creature you touch gains a luck token.
summary: A touched creature gains a luck token.

name: Prophecy
description: Commune directly with your god for guidance. Ask the GM one question. The GM answers the question truthfully using the knowledge your god possesses. You cannot cast this spell again until you complete penance.
summary: Your god truthfully answers one question.

name: Alter Size
description:
You cause a creature or an object to grow or shrink double its size. If the target is unwilling, must make a DC 13 CON check.
If the target is a creature, everything it is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item dropped by an affected creature returns to normal size at once. Any physical damage increases or decreases it’s dice damage category.
summary: Double or halve the size of a creature or object.

name: Awake Dead
description: You touch one humanoid’s remains, and it rises as a zombie or skeleton under your control. The remains must have at least three limbs and its head intact. The undead creature acts on your turn. After 1 day, the creature collapses into grave dust.
summary: Raise a corpse as a zombie or skeleton for a day.

name: Gentle Repose
description:
You touch a corpse or other remains. the target is protected from decay and can't become undead.
A failed spellcasting check kills instantly the creature. You can’t cast this spell again (forever) if you critical fail.
summary: Protect a corpse from decay and undeath.

name: Haste
description:
The selected target has its body accelerated in time, meaning it can take an additional turn per round.
When the spell ends, the target is overcome by a wave of lethargy and cannot act for 1 full round.
A failure to cast this spell causes the caster to have lethargy effect.
summary: The target takes an extra turn each round.

name: Blight
description:
Necromantic energy washes over a creature draining moisture and vitality from it.
A target plant creature of LV 4 or less instantly dies. If it is a living creature, it takes 3d8 damage instead.
A non-magical plant up to the size of a large tree is withers and dies.
summary: Drain a creature for 3d8; kills weak plants.

name: Fire Shield
description:
Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding light to a near distance (see Light Sources, pg. 84).
The shield grants immunity to cold damage. Melee attacks hitting you returns 1d6 fire damage to the attacker.
summary: Immune to cold; melee attackers take 1d6 fire.

name: Ice Shield
description:
Thin and wispy snow wreathe your body for the duration, shedding light to a near distance (see Light Sources, pg. 84).
The shield grants immunity to fire damage. Melee attacks hitting you returns 1d6 cold damage to the attacker.
summary: Immune to fire; melee attackers take 1d6 cold.

name: Vampiric Touch
description:
You imbue your touch to drain life essence.
One target you touch with a successful attack roll takes a number of d6 equal to half your level (rounded down) and you regain HP equal to the half of the damage. 
Additionally,  the target permanently loses 1 CON that can be restored only by a priest on the next 24 hours.
Undead creatures are unaffected by this spell.
summary: Drain a touched target and heal half the damage.

name: Clone
description:
This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death.
This clone needs to form inside a vessel while the spell is casting; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature. It remains inert and endures indefinitely, as long as its vessel remains undisturbed.
At any time after the clone matures for 3 months, if the original creature dies, its soul transfers to the clone, provided that the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original's equipment.
Treat a failed spellcasting check for it as a critical failure instead. Roll twice and combine both effects. If you roll a 1 instead, you intantly die additionally.
summary: Grow a duplicate that takes over when you die.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
description:
This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 20-story building.
Antipathy. The enchantment causes creatures of the kind you designated of lower level tha yours to feel an intense urge to leave the area and avoid the target.
Sympathy. The enchantment causes the specified creatures of lower level tha yours to feel an intense urge to approach the target while within 60 feet of it or able to see it.
summary: Make chosen creatures flee from or crave a target.

name: Psychic Scream
description:
You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures.
A target creature of LV 15 or less instantly dies. If it is LV 11+, it is stunned for 1d6 rounds and takes 7d6 damage instead.
Creatures that have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected.
summary: Blast the minds of up to ten creatures.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Evokes four near sized blazing meteors to crash the ground. Each one causes 10d6 fire and 10d6 bludgeoning damage.
summary: Four meteors, each 10d6 fire and 10d6 bludgeoning.

name: Mass Polymorph
description: Casts Polymorph spell (pg. 67) targeting up to ten creatures.
summary: Polymorph up to ten creatures.

name: Invulnerability
description: Immune to all damage until the spell ends.
summary: Immune to all damage.

name: Gate
description: Open a portal at a point within far to another location on any plane.
summary: Open a portal to any place on any plane.

name: Foresight
description:
The creature can't be surprised and has advantage on d20 checks. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration.
This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.
summary: Can't be surprised; advantage on d20 checks.

name: Conjure Wight
description: You energize a fresh corpse to rise as a Wight to do your bidding. It acts on your turn. After 1 day it turns to dust.
summary: Raise a fresh corpse as a wight for a day.

name: Banishment
description:
You instantly banish a creature you touch, sending it and all possessions it carries to another dimension.
You can banish an intelligent creature of LV 10 or less.
If you focus on this spell for 6 rounds in a row, a creature native to a different plane of existence than the one you’re on, it returns to its home plane.
summary: Banish a touched creature to another dimension.

name: Death Ward
summary: Wards a creature against death.

name: Drainblade
description: A melee weapon you touch becomes thirsty for blood. It now heals the wielder for an amount of HP equal to the damage it deals, encouraging the wielder to keep fighting.
summary: A melee weapon heals its wielder for the damage it deals.

name: Magic Circle against Undead
description: You draw a magic circle out to near-sized cube centered on yourself. For the spell’s duration, undead creatures LV 9 or less cannot attack or cast a hostile spell on anyone inside the circle. The undead also can’t possess, compel, or beguile anyone inside the circle.
summary: Undead of LV 9 or less can't harm those in the circle.

name: Darkness
description: You magically create darkness in a near cube within the spell’s range. Creatures inside the area are blinded and they are obscured from view from the outside. Only magical light can penetrate this magical darkness.
summary: Magical darkness blinds a near cube.

name: Locate Corpse
description: You know the direction and range of the closest nonanimated corpse.
summary: Find the direction of the nearest corpse.

name: Moses’ Passage
description: You call on your faith’s favor to part the sea. You create passages or hold back the tide in a double near cube within the spell range.
summary: Part the sea or hold back the tide.

name: Raise Dead
description:
The caster return a non-animated dead creature you touch to life with 1 hit point, but must provide a sacrifice one soul of equal level to do so. The ritual takes three rounds to cast.
The spell neutralizes any illnesses and wounds but not restore missing body parts.
summary: Bring a dead creature back at 1 HP, for a soul.

name: Lay to Rest
description: An undead creature you touch, whose level is equal to or less than yours, is instantly sent to its final afterlife, reducing it to grave dust.
summary: Turn a touched undead of your level or less to dust.

name: Magic Circle against Life
description: You draw a magic circle with necrotic energy out to nearsized cube centered on yourself. For the spell’s duration, enemy living creatures LV 9 or below cannot attack or cast a hostile spell on anyone inside the circle.
summary: Living foes of LV 9 or less can't harm those in the circle.

name: Boneskin
description: Your skin becomes covered in hardened bone armor, taking 1d8 damage to your maximum HP. For the spell’s duration, your armor class becomes 17 (20 on a critical spellcasting check.).
summary: Bone armor: AC 17, but lose 1d8 max HP.

name: Summon Mummy
description:
You summon forth a mummy from its hidden crypt who will act on your turn and do your bidding. After 5 rounds, it melts away into smoke.
A critical fail on casting this spell still summons the mummy, but it turns against you during its 5 round lifespan. Do not roll on the mishap table.
summary: A mummy fights for you for 5 rounds.

name: Mummify
description: After a day of preparation and ceremony, you embalm a corpse as a mummy who acts on your turn. Mummies deteriorate when walking long distances, but can be carried in a casket or left to guard a location. This minion does not count against the LV limit of other raised undead minions.
summary: Embalm a corpse into a lasting mummy servant.

name: Demonic Possession
description:
Your soul willingly leaves your body and occupies a target in near range. An unwilling target can make a CHA check vs. your spellcasting check. If they fail, you control the target on your turn, but your body stands in a helpless daze.
When the target returns to its body, it becomes aware of the possession, but retains no memories of what transpired. If the target dies, you return to your body as long as it is within near range, otherwise you return to your body and drop to 0 HP.
summary: Leave your body and control a creature near you.

name: Regenerate
description:
An infusion of positive energy grants a creature continuous healing. The target regains half of its hit points. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 1 hit point per turn.
Each time the creature regains hit points from regeneration, one damaged or ruined organ (if any) regrows. During the spell's duration, the creature can also take an action to reattach severed body parts.
summary: Heal half HP, then 1 HP per turn; organs regrow.

name: Fire Storm
description: You call a storm made of sheets of roaring flame, immolating five creatures you can see within range. A target takes 3d10 damage.
summary: Flames deal 3d10 to five creatures you see.

name: Control Weather
description:
You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for 1 entire day. 
You change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season.
Weather conditions will be changed in three categories: precipitation, temperature, and wind.
summary: Control the weather within 5 miles for a day.

name: Mass Heal
description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 500 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened.
summary: Split 500 HP of healing among creatures you see.

name: Divine Sight
description: You confers on a creature the ability to see all things as they actually are. The creature sees invisible creatures or objects normally, sees through illusions, and sees the true form of polymorphed, changed, or transmuted things, its eyes ignores magical darkness.
summary: See through invisibility, illusions and disguises.

name: Divine Intervention
summary: Call on your god to intervene directly.

name: Bone Balista
description:
You form a ballista made of bone from a corpse you touch.
It fires a bolt of bone shards during your turn, automatically hitting a target in near range, doing 4d6 damage. 
The bone ballista has 10 HP, 11 AC, and can be damaged by physical or magical attacks.
summary: A bone ballista auto-hits for 4d6 each turn.

name: Legend Lore
description:
Brings to your mind legends about an important person, place, or thing. The divination brings legends (if any) about the person, place, or things to your mind. These may be legends that are still current, legends that have been forgotten, or even information that has never been generally known. If the person, place, or thing is not of legendary importance, you gain no information.
The spell is cast with incense and strips of ivory formed into a rectangle, but some item of value to the caster must be sacrificed in addition (a potion, magical scroll, magical item, etc.)
summary: Recall legends about a person, place or thing.

name: Cauldron
description:
You conjure a bubbling cauldron next to you. It can produce one of the following effects: 
• Any broken mundane item placed inside the cauldron is repaired. 
• A fat, croaking toad leaps out and follows your instructions for the next 3 rounds. 
• You can place up to 3 item slots of items inside the cauldron. The cauldron expels these items the next time you cast this spell (expelling items counts as the cauldron's single effect).
summary: A cauldron mends items, spawns a toad or stores gear.

name: Eye bite
description: One creature you target takes 1d4 damage, and it can't see you until the end of its next turn.
summary: Deal 1d4 and the target can't see you next turn.

name: Dancing light
description: You summon a floating marsh light that bobs in the air and casts light out to a close radius around it. The light can change colors and take on vague shapes. It can float up to a near distance on your turn.
summary: A floating light you move and reshape.

name: Bane
description: You curse one creature to takes 1d4 penalty on the next d20 roll. Dispels bless.
summary: A creature takes -1d4 on its next d20 roll.

name: Bestow Curse
description:
You touch a creature to bestow a curse from the following effects
- Decrease an ability score up tol to your spellcasting attribute bonus.
- Disadvantage on a specific type of rolls (attacks, casting spells, STR checks etc.
- Each turn, the target has a 50% chance of taking no action.

You may also invent your own curse, but it should be no more powerful than those described above.
summary: Curse a touched creature with a lasting hindrance.

name: Cause Fear
description: You call upon the Willowman to appear in one creature's mind, filling it with supernatural terror. Choose one creature of LV 2 or less within range. That creature must immediately make a morale or fear check. Even creatures that are not normally subject to morale checks (such as undead) must do so.
summary: A creature of LV 2 or less must check morale.

name: Faerie Fire
description: A pale glow surrounds and outlines the subjects. Outlined subjects shed light as candles. Outlined creatures is always visible.
summary: Outline creatures in light so they can't hide.

name: Message
description: You can whisper messages and receive whispered replies with little chance of being overheard. You point your finger at each creature you want to receive the message. When you whisper, the whispered message is audible to all targeted creatures within range.
summary: Whisper secret messages to creatures you point at.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A coruscating ray springs from your hand. The subject takes 1d4 STR damage. The target’s STR and cannot drop below 1.
summary: A ray deals 1d4 STR damage.

name: Remove Curse
description: Remove curse instantaneously removes all curses on an object or a creature. Do not remove permanent curses but can suppress an effect to remove a wield item.
summary: Remove all non-permanent curses on a target.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Stops Near raging creatures from hostile actions. Creatures affected cannot take violent actions. Any damage on an affect creature ends the spell.
summary: Raging creatures near you can't act violently.

name: Delay Poison
description: The target becomes immune to poison for the duration of spell.
summary: The target is immune to poison.

name: Poison
summary: Poison a creature or object.

name: Desecrate
description:
Imbues a near sized area with negative energy. Undead creatures are resistant to Turn undead spell and receive +1 to all rolls.
Additionally, Animate dead and similar spells is always cast as critical success.
summary: Empower undead in a near area against turning.

name: Hideous Laughter
description: One target you touch of LV 4 or less collapses helplessly with disturbing, pained laughter for the spell's duration.
summary: A touched creature of LV 4 or less collapses laughing.

name: Speak with animals
description: You can comprehend and communicate with animals.
summary: Understand and talk with animals.

name: Summon swarm
description: A dense swarm of biting bats, rats, or locusts appears in a nearsized cube around a point you can see within range. All creatures that start their turn within the swarm take 2d6 damage and are blinded.
summary: A biting swarm blinds and deals 2d6 each turn.

name: Spidersilk
description: Sticky spidersilk covers your hands and feet. For the spell's duration, you can walk on vertical surfaces as easily as if it were flat ground.
summary: Walk on walls as if they were floors.

name: Broomstick
description: You transform a broomstick into a flying broomstick. The broomstick's rider can fly a near distance each round and can hover in place.
summary: Ride a flying broomstick a near distance per round.

name: Larissa’s dance of the dead
description: You perform choreographed and precise steps of a dance that macabrely hypnotizes those who watch. Choose a number of living creatures that can see you to take 2d8 damage. Creatures killed by the spell damage come back as zombies.
summary: A dance deals 2d8; the slain rise as zombies.

name: Danse Macabre
description:
You raise an army of skeletons to your aid from 2d4 human-like corpses. They carry whatever weapon they died with. If uknown, assume a weapon that causes 1d6 damage, such as a shortsword or mace. Your spellcasting bonus is used for any checks and determine the total HP.
They act on your turn and return to the afterlife after 10 rounds.
summary: Raise 2d4 corpses as armed skeletons.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: You flash eight multicolored rays
summary: Flash eight multicolored rays.

name: True Seeing
description: You grant a creature the ability to see all things as they truly are, up to 60 feet. The target can see through magical darkness, spot invisible creatures, detect illusions, perceive secret doors, and see the true forms of polymorphed or disguised creatures. This spell does not allow vision through solid objects or into other planes.
summary: See through darkness, invisibility and illusions.

name: Eyebite
description:
You gain a powerful gaze attack, allowing you to affect one creature within range each round. When casting, choose one of the following effects (this choice is fixed for the spell’s duration):
- Charm: The creature becomes loyal to you, following your commands as if under a charm spell.
- Fear: The creature is overcome with terror and flees from you for 1d4 rounds.
- Sicken: The creature is weakened, moving and attacking at half effectiveness for the spell’s duration.
- Sleep: The creature falls into a deep, comatose sleep.
Each creature affected can make a DC 15 WIS check to resist the effect. This spell does not affect undead or creatures on other planes.
summary: Charm, frighten or sicken one creature each round.

name: Glassee
description: You make a section of metal, stone, or wood transparent as glass, up to 3 feet wide by 2 feet high. The transparency can be limited to your sight only, or you can create a one-way window that others can see through. This effect does not work on lead, gold, or platinum. The window retains the strength of the original material.
summary: Make a patch of wall or stone see-through.

name: Domination
description:
You take control of a humanoid whose LV is half your level or lower (rounded down). 
Once dominated, the creature will follow your commands, though it may resist actions against its nature with a DC 15 WIS check. Self-destructive commands are ignored. If a protection from evil effect surrounds the target, you cannot control it while the protection lasts.
summary: Take control of a weaker humanoid.

name: Vision
description:
You call upon a powerful entity for supernatural guidance, asking one question. Roll 2d6 to determine the response:
- 2–6: The entity is displeased and refuses to answer. You are compelled to perform a quest or task for it.
- 7–9: The entity is indifferent and provides a minor vision, which may be cryptic or unrelated.
- 10+: The entity grants a clear vision answering your question.

You can sacrifice a precious item to improve your roll: +1 for a valuable item, +2 for an extremely valuable item, and +3 for a priceless item.
summary: Ask a powerful entity one question, at a risk.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: You create a twisting, colorful pattern in the air, mesmerizing creatures within a near-sized area. A total of up to 12 (or your level) Hit Dice of creatures can be affected. Creatures that see the pattern become fascinated, standing transfixed as long as you maintain focus. Any damage inflicted on an affected creature immediately breaks the spell’s effect on that creature.
summary: A pattern transfixes creatures in a near area.

name: Cone of Cold
description: You unleash a blast of frigid air from your hands in a near-sized long cone. All creatures in the area take 5d8 cold damage.
summary: A cone of frost deals 5d8 cold.

name: Color Spray
description: You project a fan of clashing colors to a close area around where you stand. Creatures with 4 Hit Dice or fewer becomes stunned for 1 round. Creatures with 2 Hit Dice or fewer who fail the check are instead knocked unconscious for 2d4 rounds.
summary: Stun or knock out weak creatures close to you.

name: Cure Light Wounds
description:
You touch a creature and restore 1d8 hit points. This spell does not affect creatures without corporeal bodies, undead, or creatures of extraplanar origin.
Reverse: Inflict 1d8 damage instead
summary: A touched creature regains 1d8 HP.

name: Cure Serious Wounds
description:
You touch a creature and restore 2d8+Half your level of hit points. This spell does not affect incorporeal, nonliving, or extraplanar creatures.
Reverse: Inflict damage instead.
summary: A touched creature regains 2d8 + half level HP.

name: Remove Fear
description: You instill courage in one creature within range, granting it advantage on checks against fear effects for the duration. If the creature failed a check against fear earlier that day, it can immediately attempt the save again with advantage. This spell has no effect on undead.
summary: Advantage against fear; retry a failed fear check.

name: Time Stop
description: You stop the flow of time within a 15-foot sphere around you, freezing all other creatures in the area. You can act for 1d4 rounds in a row. If you leave the area, the spell immediately ends, and time resumes.
summary: Freeze time and act for 1d4 rounds.

name: Audible Glamer
description: You create an illusion of sound at a location within range. The sound can resemble anything from whispering voices to roaring animals. It can remain stationary, approach, or recede as you choose. Creatures that hear the sound will believe it is real unless they have reason to doubt it.
summary: Create an illusion of any sound.

name: Animate Object
description: You animate one or more inanimate objects within range, up to a total volume of 10 cubic feet. The objects obey your commands, either attacking your designated target or performing simple tasks. Animated objects deal 1d6 damage per attack and have AC 13. They vanish or fall inert when the spell ends or when destroyed. Attempting to animate an object in someone’s possession grants them a DC 15 WIS check to resist.
summary: Animate objects that fight or work for you.

name: Shield of Force
description: A floating shield made of arcane energy hovers around you, ready to intercept attacks. You gain a +2 bonus to your armor class for the duration. The shield completely blocks magic missile.
summary: +2 to AC; blocks magic missile.

name: Ice Knife
description: You conjure a dagger of ice and hurl it at a target within range. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 damage. When the ice knife strikes, it shatters, releasing a burst of freezing air. All creatures within a Close radius take 1d4 cold damage and have their movement halved for 1d3 rounds.
summary: An ice dagger deals 2d4, then bursts with cold.

name: Spray of Cards
description: You conjure a circle of spectral cards that slice through the air out to a close area around you. Each creature in the area takes 1d10 force damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn.
summary: Spectral cards deal 1d10 and blind those close.

name: Binding Ice
description: You unleash a blast of freezing ice in a near-sized cube. Creatures in the area take 1d8 damage and its legs are frozen for 1 round.
summary: Ice deals 1d8 and freezes legs in a near cube.

name: Magnify Gravity
description: You intensify gravity in a near-sized cube around you. Each creature in the area takes has its speed limited to Close for the duration. Any unattended object within the area becomes immovable.
summary: Heavy gravity slows creatures near you.

name: Tongues
description: You gain the ability to speak and understand all languages within Near. This allows you to communicate effectively with any creature that understands language. This spell does not enable communication with animals or influence a creature’s disposition toward you.
summary: Speak and understand every language.

name: Pulse Wave
description: You create intense pressure and unleashes it, deciding if the pressure pulls or pushes near creatures and objects. Each creature in area takes 1d6 damage and is either pulled toward you or pushed away from you, depending on the choice you made for the spell.
summary: Deal 1d6 and pull or push nearby creatures.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: A creature you touch becomes invisible for the spell’s duration.
summary: A touched creature turns invisible.

name: Mental Prison
description: You trap one creature within a terrifying, illusory prison that only it perceives. The creature takes is surrounded by a deadly illusion like fiery walls, serrated blades, or other horrors you decide.  If it attempts to break free by moving or touching through the illusion, it takes an 5d10 psychic damage, and the spell ends.
summary: Trap a creature in a deadly illusion (5d10 to escape).

name: Power Word: Stun
description: You utter a word of power, stunning one near creature of level lower than 7 for 4 rounds, lower than LV 14 for 2 rounds, LV 15+ not affected.
summary: Stun one creature for up to 4 rounds.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Unleashes a bolt of lightning that strikes one creature or object, then arcs to additional targets within range. The initial target takes 6d6 damage. Each subsequent target in the chain takes 1d6 less damage than the previous target, until the spell either exhausts its power or runs out of targets. Each target can only be struck once.
summary: Lightning deals 6d6, then arcs to more targets.

name: Gust of Wind
description: You release a strong blast of wind within Near in one direction. The wind extinguishes unprotected flames, scatters light objects, and disperses vapors and gases. Man-sized creatures are held motionless if moving against the wind. Larger creatures are slowed by half for one round. Gaseous or unsecured levitating creatures are blown away from the caster.
summary: A blast of wind puts out flames and pushes creatures.

name: Suggestion
description: You compel a creature within range to follow a reasonable course of action you describe in one or two sentences. The creature must be able to understand your language. The action cannot be directly self-destructive but may involve risky or unusual behavior if worded convincingly.
summary: A creature follows a reasonable suggestion.

name: Distance Distortion
description:
You alter the dimensions of an area completely enclosed by earth, rock, or similar material. The area can be up to a Near-sized cube. You choose to either double or halve the distance across the area for those traveling within it.
Creatures affected by the distortion cannot detect the change and perceive the area as normal unless they use true seeing.
summary: Double or halve distances in an enclosed area.

name: Locate Object
description: You sense the direction of a well-known or clearly visualized object within range. If searching for a general item type, the spell directs you to the nearest one. If searching for a specific item, you must have seen it firsthand.
summary: Sense the direction of an object you know.

name: Silent Image
description:
You create a silent, motionless visual illusion of an object, creature, or force that is no larger than an elephant. You can move the illusion within the spell’s range.
Creatures that interact with the illusion in a meaningful way may realize it is fake.
summary: A silent visual illusion you can move.

name: Enthrall
description: You weave a captivating string of words, like singing, tell a story or similar, distracting creatures of your choice within range. Affected creatures is distracted as long as you maintain focus.
summary: Captivate chosen creatures while you focus.

name: Scare
description: You call upon the Willowman to appear in one creature's mind, filling it with supernatural terror. Choose one creature of LV 6 or less within range. That creature must immediately make a morale or fear check. Even creatures that are not normally subject to morale checks (such as undead) must do so.
summary: A creature of LV 6 or less must check morale.

name: Whispering Wind
description:
You send a faint, magical whisper on the wind to a specific location within range that you are familiar with. When it arrives, the wind delivers a message of up to 25 words, a brief sound lasting 1 round, or simply a faint breeze. The message is delivered regardless of whether anyone is there to hear it, after which the wind dissipates.
This spell cannot activate magical effects, speak command words, or mimic spell incantations.
summary: Send a 25-word message on the wind.

name: Clairaudience/Clairvoyance
description:
You create an invisible magical sensor at a known or obvious location within range. You can choose to hear (clairaudience) or see (clairvoyance) through the sensor, but not both at the same time. The sensor remains fixed in place, though you can rotate your view in any direction.
The sensor does not work through magical darkness and cannot benefit from supernatural or enhanced senses. It functions only on the plane you currently occupy.
summary: See or hear through a distant invisible sensor.

name: Chill Touch
description: Your hand glows with cold blue energy, channeling negative energy into a creature you touch. The target takes 3d4 damage and 1 CON and STR damage.
summary: A touch deals 3d4 and drains STR and CON.

name: Lorloveim’s Creeping Shadow
description:
Your shadow elongates and moves independently at a rate of near per round, stretching up to double near. It can slither along floors and walls but cannot physically interact with objects.
You can see, hear, and speak through your shadow as if you were there. It is 90% undetectable in dim or dark environments, but in bright light, it may be noticed. The shadow shares your AC and can only be struck by magical weapons (+1 or better) or spells. Any damage dealt to the shadow is taken by you.
summary: Send your shadow to scout for you.

name: Ray of frost
description:
You send a beam of biting cold from your outstretched hand to one creature. The target takes 1d4 damage. 
Freezes the target on the ground for one round if hit the max damage.
summary: A cold ray deals 1d4 to one creature.

name: Elemental Weapon
description:
One weapon you touch is wreathed in elemental energy.
Choose an energy type from fire, cold or electricity. The wea pon deals an additional 1d4 damage
of the chosen type for the duration.
If the energy type is anathema to the target's existence (for example, cold energy against a
fire elemental), the additional damage is doubled instead.
summary: A touched weapon deals +1d4 fire, cold or lightning.

name: Curse Water
description:
you touch a flask or some other vessel containing water and transform it into unholy water.
The entire batch of holy water can be hurled at a target that is close or near as an attack using STR or DEX. If the target is a living creature it takes 1d4 damage.
Any unholy water you have created transforms back into the water it was before after a day, or if you create more unholy water.
summary: Turn water into unholy water to throw.

name: Hex
description:
You jinx a creature you can see. The creature has disadvantage on one specific task of your choosing, excluding attacks rolls and spells.
Repeated attempts at the same task still have disadvantage
summary: A creature has disadvantage on one task you choose.

name: Inflict Wounds
description:
Your touch causes boils and blisters to erupt from skin.
Roll a number of d4s equal to half your level (rounded down). One living target you touch loses
that many hit points.
summary: A touch deals (half level) d4 damage.

name: Horns of Doom
description:
Ominous trumpets sound from the heavens.
Choose a creature you can see that defies your diety's will. The creature takes 3d6 damage
from the fiery doom that rains down upon it.
Any creatures that are near the target take 1d6 damage.
summary: Fiery doom deals 3d6 to a foe, 1d6 to those near.

name: Insect Swarm
description:
A thick swarm of locusts appears in a near sized area.
Each creature caught in the swarm has disadvantage on attack rolls and checks, and they spend
their 1st turn in the swarm unable to move. They can't see beyond the swarm, and creaures outside
the swarm cannot see in.
Each time the caster makes a spellcasting check to maintain focus, they can move the swarm to
an area in range.
summary: Locusts blind and hinder everyone in a near area.

name: Arms of Shadow
description: Dark tendrils erupt from your body, lashing out at all creatures within close. Each creature in the area takes 1d6  damage and cannot take reactions until the start of their next turn.
summary: Shadow tendrils deal 1d6 to all close to you.

name: Blade of Disaster
description:
You conjure a hovering blade of pure planar destruction. You can immediately command the blade to make two attacks right after cast. Each hit deals 3d12 damage.
The blade scores a critical hit on an 18–20, dealing 8d12 damage instead.
On each of your turns, you may move the blade up to near and make one attack.
The blade phases through all barriers, including magical ones such as wall of force.
summary: A floating blade strikes for 3d12 each turn.

name: Endless Echoes
description: You magically create ghostly sounds echoing in a near cube within the spell’s range. Creatures casting spells inside the area are distracted by the sounds, and any Focus is break.
summary: Ghostly echoes break the focus of casters inside.

name: Epiphany
description:
You use a vial of holy water to fill one creature with divine clarity and hope. 
A target suffering from a minor or moderate Horror effect can anticipate their weekly recovery check with ADV. If the target is under the effects of an Evil or profane spell, they may immediately reroll their save against that effect (no bonus).

If the target is not currently under a Horror effect, they gain divine resilience. The next Horror check within the spell’s duration, is made with ADV.
summary: Holy water eases horror and evil spells on a creature.

name: Eternal Slumber
description:
Rids the world of an undead without harm its body, freeing its soul to the afterlife.
If cast on a corpse, it becomes immune to spells like animate dead and that would interfere with its eternal rest. Also prevents a victim slain by an undead rise as a spawn.
If cast on an existing undead, it must make a DC 15 WIS check or feels an overwhelming desire to return to its grave. This desire persists for 1 day. Liches are banished to its phylactery for 24 hours.
Darklords makes this check with ADV and automatically wakes at the next dusk.
summary: Free an undead's soul or keep a corpse from rising.

name: Induce Lycanthropy
description:
You force a natural or afflicted lycanthrope you touch to assume one of its beast or hybrid forms for the spell duration. If it has both forms, it chooses which one to assume.
The transformation starts immediately, and the target loses its next action.
summary: Force a lycanthrope into its beast form.

name: Wildshape
description:
You shape shift into an animal form. You remain in animal form for a number of minutes equal to 10 x your LV. You choose the animal’s appearance. Your statistics remain the same in animal with the following changes (choose one when you shift):
• Keen: You have a +2 bonus to Wisdom checks and cannot be surprised.
• Nimble: You have a +2 bonus to Dexterity and have advantage on checks to hide and remain hidden.
• Robust: You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class, Strength, and Constitution
If you are reduced to zero HP in animal form, you revert to your true form at one HP.
—-
LV 1 - Can shape shift into an animal no larger than a boar that cannot fly. Your attacks in animal form deal 1d4 damage.
LV 3 - Can shape shift into an animal no larger than a rhinoceros that cannot fly. Your attacks in animal form deal 1d6 damage.
LV 5 - Can shape shift into an animal that can fly and is no larger than a rhinoceros. Your attacks in animal form deal 1d8 damage.
LV 7 - Can shape shift into an animal no larger than a giraffe. Your attacks in animal form deal 1d10 damage.
summary: Shift into an animal form with one boon.

name: Animal Companion
description: You verbally control one 0-level non-insect animal companion such as a fox, owl, or iguana. You can train a calm or captive animal to become new Animal Companion. You can only have one animal companion at a time, and its LV cannot not exceed yours. For every 2 LV of the animal, training takes 1 day. You must know its language to understand it.
summary: Command a loyal animal companion.

name: Molecular Rearrangement [INT]
description:
You alter the molecular structure of a small object, changing its density, hardness, or state of matter. You can turn wood into metal, solid into liquid, or make fragile objects incredibly durable. The object reverts after the duration ends.
Critical Fail: The object transforms into an unintended material or becomes brittle and breaks.
Power Score Effect: The transformation lasts 1 hour instead of 5 minutes.
summary: Change what a small object is made of.

name: Aura Sight [WIS]
description:
You perceive the auras of creatures and objects, revealing their alignment, emotions, health, or magical nature. This allows you to detect invisible creatures, enchanted items, or strong supernatural presences.
Critical Fail: Your vision is flooded with overwhelming energy, blinding you for 1d4 rounds.
Power Score Effect: You gain deeper insight, allowing you to see hidden motives or sense if a creature is lying.
summary: See auras, invisible beings and magic.

name: Clairaudience [INT]
description:
You hear sounds from a distant, known location as if you were standing there. You must be familiar with the place or describe it accurately. Cannot hear through thick magical barriers.
Critical Fail: You hear distorted whispers or phantom noises, making it impossible to distinguish real sounds for 1d6 rounds.
Power Score Effect: You can pinpoint exact voices, even in a crowded or chaotic environment.
summary: Hear a distant, known place.

name: Clairvoyance [WIS]
description:
You see a distant, familiar location as if you were present. You can look around but cannot hear sounds. Requires concentration and cannot bypass total darkness or magical concealment.
Critical Fail: Your vision is disoriented, causing you to see random locations or disturbing hallucinations for 1d4 rounds.
Power Score Effect: You gain brief insight into the past of the area, seeing recent events that occurred there.
summary: See a distant, familiar place.

name: Object Reading [WIS]
description:
By handling an item, you mentally glimpse its history, sensing who last held it, strong emotions linked to it, or important past events. The more powerful or ancient the item, the harder the reading.
Critical Fail: You receive false or misleading visions, confusing you for 1 minute.
Power Score Effect: You get an exact mental image of the previous owner’s face, name, or location.
summary: Glimpse an item's history by holding it.

name: Precognition [WIS]
description:
You receive a brief glimpse of the near future, warning you of danger, good fortune, or key events. This is vague and symbolic, not exact. Can be used once per day per person/situation.
Critical Fail: You suffer a false vision, misleading you into a poor decision or a minor penalty (-2) on your next saving throw.
Power Score Effect: Your vision is clear and actionable, allowing you to reroll one check related to the foresight within the next hour.
summary: Glimpse the near future as a vague warning.

name: Sensitivity to Psychic Impressions [WIS]
description:
You sense strong emotions or traumatic events that happened in an area or object within the last 24 hours. Can detect recent violence, supernatural influence, or lingering energy.
Critical Fail: You experience a painful psychic echo, stunning you for 1 round.
Power Score Effect: You see a brief, clear vision of an important event, knowing exactly what happened instead of vague impressions.
summary: Sense strong emotions and events left behind.

name: Detonate [INT]
description:
You cause an object or small area to violently explode, dealing 2d10 damage to creatures and objects within 5 feet. The explosion does not produce fire, but it can shatter fragile objects and cause concussive force damage.
Critical Fail: The explosion backfires, causing 1d6 damage to you and knocking you prone.
Power Score Effect: The explosion doubles in size or ignites flammable materials.
summary: Make an object or small area explode.

name: Disintegrate [INT]
description:
You completely erase a non-living object (no larger than 5 cubic feet) from existence. Against a creature, they must have less than 50 HP or the effect fails. Living creatures get no save but must be weaker than you (DM’s discretion).
Critical Fail: The energy overloads, draining you of half your remaining PSPs and stunning you for 1 round.
Power Score Effect: You can affect a larger area (10 cubic feet) or remove a creature up to 75 HP.
summary: Erase an object, or a weak creature.

name: Project Force [INT]
description:
You create an invisible force blast, knocking a creature back 10 feet or dealing 1d8 damage if they hit a wall or hard surface. Can be used to push heavy objects or slam doors open.
Critical Fail: The force backfires, sending you flying backward 5 feet instead.
Power Score Effect: The force doubles in power, pushing targets 20 feet or dealing 2d8 damage.
summary: Blast a creature back with unseen force.

name: Telekinesis [INT]
description:
You mentally lift and move objects up to 200 lbs. If used on a creature, they can resist with Strength vs. your Power Score. You can throw or drop objects as an attack, dealing 1d6 per 50 lbs.
Critical Fail: You lose control, causing the object to drop or move randomly, possibly hitting allies.
Power Score Effect: You can move up to 500 lbs and hold concentration without spending PSPs for 1 round.
summary: Lift and move objects with your mind.

name: Animal Affinity [CON]
description:
You temporarily gain the physical abilities of an animal, choosing from enhanced Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. This provides +2 to the chosen ability score and grants related advantages (e.g., a cheetah’s speed, a bear’s strength).
Critical Fail: Your body malfunctions, causing you to suffer -2 to all physical stats for the duration instead.
Power Score Effect: You gain +4 instead of +2 and can combine two abilities (e.g., speed and strength).
summary: Gain the body of an animal.

name: Complete Healing [CON]
description:
You completely heal a target, restoring all lost HP and removing diseases or poisons. You must touch the target and concentrate for 1 full round before the effect takes place.
Critical Fail: You suffer 1d6 damage as the energy backlashes into your body instead of healing.
Power Score Effect: You also restore lost limbs or cure magical afflictions.
summary: Fully heal a target and cure ailments.

name: Death Field [CON]
description:
You emit a wave of pure life-draining energy, dealing 4d10 damage to all creatures within range (15-foot radius). Weaker creatures (less than half your HD) must save vs. death or die instantly.
Critical Fail: The energy turns against you, dealing half damage to yourself.
Power Score Effect: Damage increases to 5d10, and creatures with less than ⅔ your HD must save or die.
summary: A life-draining wave hurts all nearby.

name: Energy Containment [CON]
description:
You absorb and store energy-based attacks, such as fire, lightning, or magic missiles. Instead of taking damage, you harmlessly absorb the attack, storing up to 30 points of damage. You can release this stored energy later, dealing half of it as a blast.
Critical Fail: Instead of absorbing, you take double damage from the attack.
Power Score Effect: You can absorb up to 50 points and release the full stored damage instead of half.
summary: Absorb energy attacks, then release them.

name: Life Draining [CON]
description:
You touch a target and drain their vitality, dealing 3d8 damage while healing yourself for half the damage inflicted. The target must fail a saving throw vs. death or suffer 1d4 permanent HP loss.
Critical Fail: The energy backlashes, dealing 1d6 damage to yourself instead.
Power Score Effect: You heal all the damage dealt instead of half.
summary: Drain a target's life to heal yourself.

name: Metamorphosis [CON]
description:
You completely reshape your body, mimicking another humanoid race, growing natural weapons, or adapting to an environment (e.g., gills for water breathing). You cannot mimic specific individuals, only general forms.
Critical Fail: Your transformation partially fails, leaving you deformed (-2 to Charisma) for the duration.
Power Score Effect: You gain one extra enhancement, such as natural armor, extra limbs, or enhanced speed.
summary: Reshape your body to a new form.

name: Shadow-form [CON]
description:
You partially shift into shadow, making you 50% harder to hit and allowing you to move through narrow spaces. You can still be damaged by light-based attacks and cannot pass through solid objects.
Critical Fail: You become stuck between forms, suffering 1d4 Constitution damage until you rest.
Power Score Effect: You become completely intangible, immune to non-magical attacks for 1 round per level.
summary: Become shadow: harder to hit, slip through gaps.

name: Banishment [WIS]
description:
You forcefully eject a creature from this plane, sending them to a random extraplanar location. If the target has fewer Hit Dice than you, they receive no saving throw. If their HD is equal or higher, they must make a saving throw vs. spells to resist.
Critical Fail: The effect backfires, sending you to another plane instead.
Power Score Effect: You can select the plane where the creature is sent rather than it being random.
summary: Eject a creature to a random plane.

name: Probability Travel [WIS]
description:
You phase through alternate realities, selectively choosing the one with the best possible outcome for your actions. While active, you gain +2 to attack rolls, AC, and saving throws. If used for movement, you automatically bypass obstacles or traps. You can bring 1 willing creature per level along with you.
Critical Fail: You become temporarily lost in the timestream, unable to act for 1d4 rounds.
Power Score Effect: The bonuses increase to +4, and you can extend the effect to non-willing creatures, forcing them into a different probability.
summary: Pick the best outcome: bonuses to attacks, AC and saves.

name: Summon Planar Creature [WIS]
description:
You open a rift to another plane, summoning a creature native to that plane. The creature’s HD cannot exceed your level, and its reaction to you depends on the plane of origin and the circumstances.
Critical Fail: A hostile creature is summoned instead, attacking indiscriminately.
Power Score Effect: You summon a stronger creature (HD +2), and it is friendly by default.
summary: Open a rift and summon a planar creature.

name: Teleport [WIS]
description:
You instantly transport yourself to a known location within 100 miles per level. The success depends on familiarity:
• Very familiar: No error.
• Seen once: 10% chance of failure.
• Described only: 30% chance of failure.
If failed, you land in a random nearby location.
Critical Fail: You arrive partially embedded in solid matter, taking 4d10 damage.
Power Score Effect: You can bring additional creatures (up to 1 per level).
summary: Jump to a known place up to 100 miles per level away.

name: Teleport Other [WIS]
description:
You teleport a creature or object within range to a location you know. If the target is unwilling, they must fail a saving throw vs. spells to be affected. The teleportation follows the same accuracy rules as Teleport.
Critical Fail: The target is sent to a completely unknown location, potentially very dangerous.
Power Score Effect: The target cannot resist (no saving throw).
summary: Send a creature or object to a place you know.

name: Time/Space Anchor [WIS]
description:
You create an invisible barrier that prevents all forms of teleportation, planar travel, or phasing within a 30-foot radius. Any creature attempting to teleport or shift must make a saving throw vs. spells or be stopped.
Critical Fail: The effect reverses, making teleportation easier instead (-2 penalty to saves against teleportation).
Power Score Effect: The anchor lasts 1 hour instead of 10 rounds.
summary: Block teleportation and planar travel in an area.

name: Domination [CHA]
description:
You take full control of a creature’s actions. The target must fail a saving throw vs. spells to resist. The dominated creature acts as you command, though self-destructive orders allow a new saving throw.
Critical Fail: Your mind is momentarily overwhelmed, leaving you stunned for 1 round.
Power Score Effect: The domination lasts 1 minute per level instead of rounds.
summary: Take full control of a creature's actions.

name: Fate Link [CHA]
description:
You mentally link yourself to a target, causing both of you to share all damage taken (split 50/50). If one of you is stunned, blinded, or paralyzed, the other suffers the same effect.
Critical Fail: The link malfunctions, causing you to take all of the target’s damage for 1d4 rounds.
Power Score Effect: You can link multiple creatures (up to 3 total).
summary: Share damage and conditions with a target.

name: Mass Domination [CHA]
description:
As Domination, but you can control up to 3 creatures simultaneously. Targets must fail a saving throw vs. spells to resist. They will not obey blatantly suicidal commands.
Critical Fail: Your mind is overwhelmed, rendering you unable to use Telepathy powers for 1d6 rounds.
Power Score Effect: You can dominate up to 5 creatures at once.
summary: Dominate up to 3 creatures at once.

name: Mindlink [CHA]
description:
You establish a direct mental connection with a willing creature, allowing instant communication regardless of distance. If the creature is unwilling, they must fail a saving throw vs. spells to resist.
Critical Fail: The connection is unstable, giving you incoherent thoughts and distracting mental noise for 1d6 rounds (-2 to concentration-based actions).
Power Score Effect: The link becomes permanent, lasting until you choose to end it.
summary: Talk mind to mind at any distance.

name: Mindwipe [CHA]
description:
You erase specific memories from a creature’s mind. You can remove up to 1 hour per level of memories. The target must fail a saving throw vs. spells to be affected.
Critical Fail: Your own mind suffers a temporary backlash, causing you to forget a random piece of information for 1 hour.
Power Score Effect: You can implant false memories instead of just erasing them.
summary: Erase memories from a creature's mind.

name: Probe [CHA]
description:
You delve into a creature’s mind, uncovering surface thoughts and recent memories. If the target is aware of the intrusion, they can resist with a saving throw vs. spells.
Critical Fail: The target notices and resists forcefully, causing 1d6 psychic damage to you.
Power Score Effect: You gain access to deep memories, uncovering secrets, motives, or hidden knowledge.
summary: Read surface thoughts and recent memories.

name: Superior Invisibility [CHA]
description:
You mentally erase your presence from the minds of others, making yourself completely undetectable. This invisibility cannot be seen even by magical detection, though creatures immune to mind-affecting effects (like undead) can still perceive you.
Critical Fail: Your mind becomes partially disconnected, giving you -2 to all actions for 1d4 rounds.
Power Score Effect: The effect lasts 10 rounds per level instead of 5.
summary: Vanish from the minds of others.

name: Switch Personality [CHA]
description:
You swap minds with a creature, placing your consciousness in their body and theirs in yours. The target must fail a saving throw vs. spells to resist. If your body dies while in another’s, your consciousness remains trapped in their body permanently.
Critical Fail: The swap half-succeeds, causing both minds to be partially entangled, giving both characters -2 to Intelligence and Wisdom for 1d6 hours.
Power Score Effect: The switch becomes permanent until you choose to reverse it.
summary: Swap minds with a creature.
